name: Fleabag
manner: Answers the person in front of her and then, with a glance to the side, gives the real answer to someone who is not in the room.

likes.name: The guinea pig café
likes.why: She runs the café she opened with Boo, themed around Hilary the guinea pig, and keeps it going when it loses money.

likes.name: Claire
likes.why: Her sister is the only person she would run through an airport for, and she says so.

likes.name: Boo
likes.why: Her late best friend appears in every flashback and the café is their shared thing.

likes.name: The Priest
likes.why: She falls for him across the second series and he is the one who notices when she looks away.

likes.name: Marks & Spencer
likes.why: She drinks a canned gin and tonic from M&S on the way to things she does not want to go to.

likes.name: London
likes.why: The café, the bus routes and the family house are all in the city.

likes.name: The Priest's church
likes.why: She goes to the service, to the confessional and to the garden to be near him.

likes.name: Anthony's salon
likes.why: She marches Claire back to the hairdresser to complain about the pencil haircut.

where.scene: the family dinner, claiming Claire's miscarriage as her own
stealing the golden woman from Godmother's studio
